description: QUEUE-RELOAD (tower_infra.queue_deploy): whether the merge queue's words order a code-only merge's reload in place. The doorbell workflow's merge_group job rings prepare when the queue builds a merge's commit (the service classifies it from last-sha with last-sha's classifier and puts its code bundle) and landed when main moves to it (the service checks main and last-sha against the repository, then orders the service alone to load the bundle, as FAST-PATH-RELOAD). True (the default) runs it; false leaves every merge to the deploy build the push rings, as before.
